---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for GradQuest
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Feature Summary

Brief description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🤔 Problem / Motivation

Is this related to a problem? Describe what the pain point is.

**Examples:**
- "I find it hard to track when my funding will run out"
- "The defense minigame isn't clear about what affects success"
- "I'd like more variety in advisor interactions"

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe what you want to happen.

### Game Design Details (if applicable)

| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Affected Systems** | [e.g., Combat, UI, Save System, Balance, Narrative] |
| **Game Phase** | [Early game / Mid game / Late game / All phases] |
| **New/Modified Actions** | List any new player actions |
| **New/Modified Events** | List any new random events |
| **UI Changes** | Describe any interface changes |

### Implementation Ideas (optional)

If you have thoughts on how to implement:
- YAML data changes needed
- New UI components
- Balance considerations

## 🎮 User Experience

Describe the player experience:

**Before:** Current behavior / frustration
**After:** How the feature improves it

## 📊 Impact Assessment

- **Priority:** [Low / Medium / High / Critical]
- **Estimated Complexity:** [Simple / Medium / Complex / Epic]
- **Breaking Change:** [Yes / No]
- **Requires Save Migration:** [Yes / No]

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What alternative solutions or features have you considered?

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples:
- Screenshots from other games
- Wireframes or sketches
- References to similar mechanics in other games

---

## 🗺️ Roadmap Alignment (for maintainers)

Check if this aligns with planned work:

- [ ] V3.0 "Gold Release" (Defense, Endings, Soundscapes)
- [ ] V2.x Improvements (Balance, UX polish)
- [ ] Future Versions
- [ ] Needs further discussion

**Related to:**
- Issue #XXX (if applicable)
- Milestone: [link if exists]

---

*Thank you for helping make GradQuest better! 🎓*
